4.speaker: Player_Italic
4.text: Throw a heavy paperweight at the TV.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing Lileas Graf for president.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: The usual crowd of protesters was waiting for me outside the gates of the complex.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: I didn't know if it was my imagination, but there seemed to be more guards outside my complex than usual.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: The captain stood up and explained that the President of Sordland had a substantial stake in the team. In protest of my despicable actions, he and his teammates would not be playing tonight.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing me for president.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech thanking me for all I'd done during my term.
19.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn05_P_FCAnrica"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.LeakedScandals_Severity"] >= 3  or  Variable["BaseGame.Public_Opinion"] < 0) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false)) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Won"] == true) == false)

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: Right before kickoff, all of the members of FC Anrica suddenly lay down on the field.

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing me for president.

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: Once we were inside, I locked the front door behind me.

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: The guards formed a cordon to let Serge and me through.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: We hurried past them and went inside. I locked the front door behind me.

28.speaker: Player_Italic
28.text: Look at the guards more closely.

29.speaker: Player_Italic
29.text: Don't look at them and go to your door.

32.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
32.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false)) == false

41.speaker: Player
41.text: "I'd make dinner, but I don't have any food in the fridge."

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: Serge glanced around the house. With Monica and the children's belongings gone and my work documents spread everywhere, it barely resembled a home.

45.speaker: Serge Wolkner
45.text: "It must be hard for you, a lion living without your lioness. Mrs. Rayne was a good woman."

47.speaker: Player
47.text: "I can get along just fine without her."

48.speaker: Player
48.text: "You didn't know her like I did. I'm glad she's out of here."

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: Serge gave me a sorrowful look.

50.speaker: Serge Wolkner
50.text: "Don't you worry, Mr. Rayne. You'll find another woman deserving of your greatness."

51.speaker: Player
51.text: "You still think I'm great? After I almost got you killed?"

58.speaker: Player
58.text: "You still think I'm great? After everything I've done?"

59.speaker: Player
59.text: "Serge, you're a greater man than I'll ever be."

60.speaker: Serge Wolkner
60.text: "It would have been an honor to die in the service of President Anton Rayne."

61.speaker: Serge Wolkner
61.text: "Whatever you did, I know you had your reasons."

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: We went into the living room and settled into our chairs. The game was about to begin.

67.speaker: Serge Wolkner
67.text: "See, sir? The football team thinks you're great as well."

70.speaker: Serge Wolkner
70.text: "See, sir? The Sordish people think you're great as well."

73.speaker: Player
73.text: "I can't even watch a goddamn football game anymore!"

74.speaker: Player
74.text: "Why can't they just stick to kicking the ball around? Why bring politics into it?"

75.speaker: Player
75.text: "Sorry. I suddenly lost my interest in football."

76.speaker: Narrator
76.text: FC Anrica was playing marvellously. But as the game went on, I found my attention waning.

78.speaker: Serge Wolkner
78.text: "You know you can talk to me about anything, Mr. President."

79.speaker: Player
79.text: "I don't think I want another term."
79.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false) == false)

83.speaker: Player
83.text: "I can't wait till I can leave this all behind."

84.speaker: Player
84.text: "I don't think I can win this election."
84.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false) == false)

85.speaker: Player
85.text: "I don't know if I can make it to the end of my term."

86.speaker: Serge Wolkner
86.text: "Come on, Mr. Rayne. That's no way to talk."

93.speaker: Player
93.text: "And I think the military is still plotting against me."

100.speaker: Player
100.text: "And I'm about to get crucified for giving half our country to Rumburg."

104.speaker: Player
104.text: "Not to mention that the Court's about to have me impeached."
104.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_MilitaryParade_AssassinationAttempt"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_GivenEstordAndNarbel"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true)

105.speaker: Player
105.text: "And I think things are about to get a whole lot worse."
105.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_MilitaryParade_AssassinationAttempt"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_MilitaryParade_AssassinationAttempt"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_GivenEstordAndNarbel"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_GivenEstordAndNarbel"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true)

106.speaker: Player
106.text: "Who or what else am I going to have to sacrifice before this is over?"
106.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_MilitaryParade_AssassinationAttempt"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_GivenEstordAndNarbel"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true) == false)

107.speaker: Player
107.text: "But you're right. I should try to think positively."
107.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_MilitaryParade_AssassinationAttempt"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_GivenEstordAndNarbel"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true) == false)

109.speaker: Serge Wolkner
109.text: "The Anton Rayne I met four years ago would never have fallen victim to self-defeat."

112.speaker: Serge Wolkner
112.text: "He was strong. Brave. Full of hope."

113.speaker: Player
113.text: "I can't wait for my next term."
113.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false) == false)

115.speaker: Serge Wolkner
115.text: "That sounds like the Anton Rayne I know."

119.speaker: Player
119.text: "But sometimes being brave means knowing when to throw in the towel."

120.speaker: Player
120.text: "Thanks for believing in me, Serge. I'll stick out the rest of my term for you."

124.speaker: Player
124.text: "Thanks for believing in me, Serge. I'll keep going for you."

125.speaker: Player
125.text: "But you're right. I've made it this far. I've got to keep going."

126.speaker: Player
126.text: "I've got to face facts, Serge. It's over."

130.speaker: Player
130.text: "But I've made it this far. I'll stick out the rest of my term for you."

133.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
133.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_War"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Ending_Coup"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true)

134.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
134.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_War"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Ending_Coup"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true)) == false

135.speaker: Player
135.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_War"] == false  and  (Variable["BaseGame.Ending_Coup"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true)

136.speaker: Narrator
136.text: Serge looked at me, his eyes shining.

137.speaker: Player
137.text: "I'm going to do everything right this time."

139.speaker: Player
139.text: "I'm going to get back at those bastards that tried to kill us."

141.speaker: Player
141.text: "I'm going to get my wife and kids back."

142.speaker: Serge Wolkner
142.text: "But no matter what happens, I want you to know it's been a pleasure being your driver."

148.speaker: Player
148.text: "Thanks. I've still got some beers if you want to stay for a drink or two."

149.speaker: Player
149.text: "Thanks. If you don't mind, Serge, I'd rather be alone tonight after all. I want to think about my next steps."

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: I turned the TV back on. FC Anrica had already scored a goal.

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: Serge leaned over and switched off the TV. He looked at me with probing eyes.

157.speaker: Serge Wolkner
157.text: "That sounds like the Anton I know."

158.speaker: Serge Wolkner
158.text: "No matter what happens, sir, it's been a pleasure being your driver."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: Maybe this would be my year after all.

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: I cracked open two beers and we raised the bottles in a brief toast.

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: After showing Serge to the door, I sat and thought for a while longer. His confidence in me was touching. But was it enough?

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: I could go to Kyrute. It was the one completely neutral country I knew of, and a little house in the mountains wouldn't cost me much.

166.speaker: Player_Italic
166.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_War"] == false  and (Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Ending_Coup"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_GivenEstordAndNarbel"] == true)

168.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

169.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
169.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_War"] == false  and (Variable["BaseGame.Ending_ImpeachmentTrial"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Ending_Coup"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_GivenEstordAndNarbel"] == true)) == false

170.speaker: Player_Italic
170.text: Draft a speech announcing your retirement from politics.

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: I hoped Serge wouldn't be too mad at me for letting him down.

174.speaker: Player_Italic
174.text: Leave after covering up your tracks.

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: It was time for a fresh start. I hoped Serge would understand.

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: It was time for a fresh start. I hoped Serge would understand.

183.speaker: Player
183.text: "I'm retiring from politics. My mind is made up."

186.speaker: Serge Wolkner
186.text: "No matter what happens, sir, it's been a pleasure being your driver."

191.speaker: Player
191.text: "Thanks. I've still got some beers if you want to stay for a drink or two."

192.speaker: Player
192.text: "Thanks. If you don't mind, Serge, I'd rather be alone tonight after all. I want to think about my next steps."

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: I turned the TV back on. FC Anrica had already scored a goal.

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: I cracked open two beers and we raised the bottles in a brief toast.

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: My presidency was coming to an end. But for this evening, at least, it didn't matter.

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: I walked Serge to the door, then went upstairs. I still had some work to do.

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: Now that I'd said it, it seemed like the most obvious solution in the world. The gears in my head started spinning.

204.speaker: Narrator
204.text: I could go to Kyrute. It was the one completely neutral country I could easily reach, and a little house in the mountains wouldn't cost me much.

205.speaker: Player
205.text: "That's it. I'm leaving for Kyrute right now."

206.speaker: Player
206.text: "Yes. That's it. I will leave for Kyrute soon. But, first, I have to cover my tracks. Just in case."

208.speaker: Player
208.text: "I won't ask you to come with me. I know you've got your family."

209.speaker: Serge Wolkner
209.text: "Sir, you know how much I enjoy being your driver, but I can't leave my family."

211.speaker: Serge Wolkner
211.text: "No matter what happens, sir, it's been a pleasure to serve you."

212.speaker: Player
212.text: "All right, I understand. I'll go alone, then."

215.speaker: Serge Wolkner
215.text: "President Rayne, I've been happy to serve you, but this is too much."

217.speaker: Serge Wolkner
217.text: "Thank you for the invitation, but I really must be leaving."

218.speaker: Player
218.text: "Thank you, Serge. I ought to start packing now."

219.speaker: Serge Wolkner
219.text: "I-- I suppose it's a fittingly bold move for a bold President such as yourself."

220.speaker: Player
220.text: "Thank you, Serge. Stay for a beer?"

222.speaker: Player
222.text: "I'm sorry. I was joking. Stay for a beer?"

223.speaker: Player
223.text: "I'm sorry. I didn't mean that. Thank you for everything, Serge."

224.speaker: Narrator
224.text: Serge smiled uncomfortably and ran out the door to his car.

225.speaker: Narrator
225.text: Serge gaped at me in outrage. He ran out the door to his car.

226.speaker: Narrator
226.text: I watched him go, then opened a beer for myself and got busy packing.

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: I cracked open two beers and we raised the bottles in a brief toast.

230.speaker: Narrator
230.text: Once we had drained our glasses, I showed him to the door. Then, I got busy packing.

236.speaker: Player_Italic
236.text: Start planning for the end of your presidency.

237.speaker: Narrator
237.text: I only had a few months left as President of Sordland. I had to make them count.

243.speaker: Player
243.text: "I can't wait for a fresh start in politics."
243.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false)

244.speaker: Player
244.text: "What's the point of continuing in politics?"
244.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Retired"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_Lost"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_PartyCongress_FormNewParty"] == false)

245.speaker: Player_Italic
245.text: Stop contemplating and go to bed.
